Original IHP130 WNS -455.18 ns remains historical. P7 post-fix SAFE24 observations include ICS55 -152.03/-0.31 ns and IHP130 -253.43/-0.49 ns setup/hold WNS.
Negative slack and incomplete constraints remain visible. Successful analysis execution is not timing closure; later campaigns keep their own source/configuration.
Final complete product
PIO-lite remains unintegrated; PPALite is integrated through P3. Complete-product timing, physical/PVT, IO/board/package and silicon/power qualification remain open.
The final combined campaign must identify the same complete implementation, source, profile, PDK and netlist.
Discovery discrepancies
DMA max-burst readback truncates 16 to zero. SPI CAPABILITY bit 7 reads zero although Tiny connects the V2.2 DMA path.
Preserve raw readback and actual integration separately; changes to RTL or HAL require a separate engineering task.
